text: In Lab 15 the nonlinear node emulates a Mach–Zehnder modulator, whose response is modeled by the ___ function applied to (feedback + masked input + φ₀).
explanation: The lab implements x = sin²(η·x(t−τ) + ε·mask·u + φ₀) with φ₀ = π/4, i.e. np.sin(...)**2 — the Mach–Zehnder modulator's sin² (intensity) transfer curve. This bounded nonlinearity supplies the required nonlinear mixing of input and delayed feedback; because sin² ∈ [0,1] the state stays bounded and merely saturates rather than diverging at high gain.
